senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נענע a. יְנִי II) (neut. verb) to move quickly; to glisten, be bright.

units: Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXII the Messiah is named Yinnon (v. יִנּוֹן) שהוא עתיר ליַינֵּן ישני עפר (Mus. quotes לִינוֹן Kal, cmp. לִישוֹן fr. ישן, Koh. V, 11) for he will awaken those sleeping in the dust; Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIII לִינוֹן (missing in ed. Bub.); Yalk. Kings 200 עתיד ליינן רשעי ארץ he will stir up the wicked of the earth; Yalk. Gen. 45 ליַאנֵּן לעבו״ם.
